candidate.definition_en: The legal state of being unable to pay outstanding debts.
candidate.explanation_ar: حالة قانونية لما الشخص أو الشركة مايقدروش يسددوا ديونهم، يعني 'فلّسوا' رسميًا.

senses.definition_en: The legal state of being unable to pay outstanding debts.
senses.definition_ar: حالة قانونية رسمية تنشأ عند عجز شخص أو مؤسسة عن سداد ديونها (الإفلاس المالي).
examples: The company declared bankruptcy last year.
Many small businesses face bankruptcy during a recession.

senses.definition_en: The state of being completely lacking in a particular desirable quality or value.
senses.definition_ar: انعدام تام لقيمة معينة أو مبدأ أخلاقي (إفلاس معنوي أو فكري).
examples: The moral bankruptcy of the regime was evident to all.
The company declared bankruptcy last year.
Many small businesses face bankruptcy during a recession.
The moral bankruptcy of the regime was evident to all.
candidate.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bank' (بنك) و'Rupt' تشبه 'Rupture' (تمزق أو كسر)؛ يعني علاقتك بالبنك انكسرت ولم يعد معك مال لسداد ديونك.
